limits: Monitor covers startup, serial captures and service shutdown; the last sample can precede final exit by the sampling interval. Recorder and API observer are excluded.
System memory and pre-existing swap include other applications; growth cannot all be attributed to PRISM.
RSS is resident pages, not total model allocation; do not sum overlapping unified-memory figures.
Sampling can miss brief processes and peaks; eight serial repeated inputs do not establish simultaneous-room capacity.
